'''Trandoshan ale''' was a type of [[Ale/Legends|ale]]. During the [[Raid on the Gilded Star|raid on the ''Gilded Star'']], [[Gault Rennow]] took fourteen bottles of Trandoshan ale from [[Dretcher]].
